verdicts.reason: A: Drops the sea photo completely. The logo is centred while the text is left-aligned, and the copy sits tight to the left edge. The headline breaks with '$89' alone on the second line, and the subhead leaves 'Sunday.' orphaned. It is still clean, readable and on brand. B: The photo is cropped to a thin strip of sky with no sea, and the white logo sits on light sky with almost no contrast. A large empty blue area separates it from the text, which is crammed at the bottom. The centred CTA clashes with the left-aligned copy, though the headline does fit on one line.
